title: Engineer , Sr Engineer - Test  ATE RF
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION RF ATE TEST ENGINEER Department: Test Development Services (TDS)
 Function: Semiconductor Test Development / IC Testing
 Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India
 Experience: 3–14 Years
 Position Code: RF_01 : RF ATE Test Engineer (3-5 Years exp. ) Position Code: RF_02 : Sr RF ATE Test Engineer (5-14 years)
 Employment Type: Full-Time 1. Job Purpose To develop, debug, characterize, and optimize Automated Test Equipment (ATE) test solutions for RF, Analog, and Mixed-Signal semiconductor devices. The role will support the complete product lifecycle, from first-silicon bring-up and characterization to production test release, yield improvement, and high-volume manufacturing. 2. Key Responsibilities A. ATE Test Development Develop, debug, and optimize production test programs for RF, Analog, and Mixed-Signal ICs. Design and implement test solutions using Advantest V93K (SmarTest 8 preferred) or Teradyne UltraFLEX/J750 platforms. Develop and maintain test methodologies to ensure accurate, repeatable, and reliable device measurements. Support test program optimization, test coverage improvement, and production test-time reduction. B. Product Characterization and Validation Support first-silicon bring-up, device characterization, production test development, qualification, and production release. Execute characterization across Process, Voltage, and Temperature (PVT) conditions. Develop and characterize RF, Analog, and Mixed-Signal circuit blocks, including: Phase-Locked Loops (PLLs) Analog-to-Digital Converters (ADCs) Digital-to-Analog Converters (DACs) Oscillators and timing devices Power management circuits RF transceivers and related IPs Correlate ATE measurements with laboratory bench measurements and validation results. C. RF Measurement and Data Analysis Perform RF characterization and testing involving frequency, output power, phase noise, harmonics, linearity, and sensitivity, as applicable to the device under test. Analyze characterization data and identify performance trends, outliers, and potential failure mechanisms. Use data analysis tools such as Excel, MATLAB, Python, or JMP to support engineering decisions. D. Debugging and Yield Improvement Investigate test failures, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Drive yield improvement, test coverage enhancement, and product quality initiatives. Identify opportunities to optimize test time and reduce manufacturing costs without compromising quality or reliability. Support production ramp-up and resolve ATE-related issues in high-volume manufacturing environments. E. Cross-Functional Collaboration and Documentation Collaborate with Design, Product Engineering, Validation, Applications, and Manufacturing teams throughout the product development cycle. Prepare test specifications, characterization reports, test documentation, and production release packages. Support product qualification, release readiness, and ongoing manufacturing improvements. 3. Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related discipline. 3–7 years of relevant experience in semiconductor ATE test development, preferably involving RF, Analog, or Mixed-Signal products. Hands-on experience with at least one of the following ATE platforms: Advantest V93K – SmarTest 8 preferred Teradyne UltraFLEX / J750 Strong understanding of RF fundamentals, analog and digital electronics, mixed-signal testing, and semiconductor device characterization. Practical experience in RF measurement and characterization techniques. Familiarity with production test development, device characterization, and test program debugging. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Effective communication and collaboration skills for working in cross-functional engineering teams. 4. Preferred Skills Experience testing RF ICs, PLLs, oscillators, transceivers, wireless connectivity devices, or timing products. Knowledge of RF bench instruments and measurement techniques, where applicable. Understanding of semiconductor product engineering, manufacturing processes, and production release requirements. Experience in statistical data analysis, yield improvement, and systematic failure analysis. Exposure to test-time optimization, cost reduction, and continuous improvement initiatives. Programming or data analysis experience using Python, MATLAB, Excel, or JMP. 5. Key Competencies ATE Test Program Development and Debugging RF and Mixed-Signal Characterization Semiconductor Test Methodologies Data Analysis and Technical Problem-Solving Root-Cause Analysis and Yield Improvement Test-Time Optimization Cross-Functional Collaboration Documentation and Process Discipline 6. Performance Expectations Success in this role will be demonstrated through: Timely development, debugging, and release of production-ready ATE test programs. Improved test coverage, measurement accuracy, and test repeatability. Effective characterization and correlation of ATE and bench results. Measurable contributions to yield improvement and test-time optimization. Timely resolution of production test issues and adherence to product quality requirements. 7. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is a hands-on semiconductor test professional with practical ATE programming and debugging experience, a strong foundation in RF and Mixed-Signal electronics, and the ability to support product characterization through production ramp-up. title: System Administrator
description:
Summary: This role is the primary point of contact for IT support within the organization, helping employees resolve laptop issues, account access problems, software installations, and everyday technical queries. It is an ideal opportunity to build a strong IT foundation while being guided and mentored by an experienced senior team. 
 Position Overview: The System Administrator” is responsible for maintaining smooth day-to-day IT operations across the organization. This role covers end-user support, asset management, system upkeep, and vendor coordination, making it a well-rounded position for someone looking to grow within an IT support function. 
 Key Responsibilities: Provide day-to-day support to employees on tickets, laptops, logins, printers, software installations, and related requests. Complete daily preventive checks across the office — verifying that IT hardware, servers, UPS, and internet links are up, both physically and logically — and act on any deviation. Build and deliver new laptops end to end: imaging, domain join, host ID and AD account creation, project-specific software, endpoint agent installation, asset tagging, and user handover. Maintain the asset register and host ID records accurately, and provision test PCs and virtual machines against validated user requirements, tracking usage duration and reclaiming resources on expiry. Manage the user account lifecycle — email IDs, AD accounts, distribution lists and group memberships, password resets, and access provisioning and revocation during onboarding and exit. Test and deploy Windows and third-party patches through the endpoint management console, monitor patch non-compliance reports, and resolve the root cause of failures. Maintain endpoint security compliance: monitor antivirus and endpoint protection consoles, bring non-compliant systems back into compliance, respond to threat and data-loss-prevention alerts, and validate licence terms for software approval requests. Run scheduled backups of servers, Active Directory, and databases to the NAS, and perform periodic restore checks with project teams to confirm data integrity. Coordinate with vendors for hardware, software, and facility requirements — obtaining and comparing quotes, securing approvals, releasing purchase orders, and following up until delivery and installation. Support network and infrastructure monitoring, including Wi-Fi and LAN authentication, firewall and CCTV checks, and report anomalies to the senior team. Keep trackers, checklists, and basic documentation current to support ISO audits, knowledge sharing, and team organisation. Escalate recurring or complex issues to the Team Lead or Senior System Administrator for permanent resolution. 
 Qualifications: Diploma, BCA, B.Sc., or B.E. (Postgraduate candidates will not be considered.) Proficient with Windows, Outlook, and standard office productivity software. Basic understanding of networks, Wi-Fi, and general office IT infrastructure. Some familiarity with Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace. 1–5 years of hands-on IT support or system administration experience. A helpful and patient approach to working directly with end-users. Willingness to learn new tools and adapt quickly in a dynamic environment. 
 Benefits: We want every Soliton member to grow to their highest potential. Our work environment helps individuals explore their interests and potential and reach out to the resources and people available at Soliton to realize them. Read more about what it’s like to work at Soliton. Careers | Soliton Technologies Solitons choose their work hours as long as it takes into account the requirements of the job. We take special care to support mothers to excel at work while they handle their responsibilities at home. At Soliton, we believe that every team member contributes to our success and revenue, directly or indirectly. To recognize this, we share a portion of our profits with all Solitons. Starting from your second year with us, you’ll be eligible to receive a share of the company’s profits. Health insurance for employees and families, gym and cycle allowance – your health is a priority! 
 About Soliton: Soliton Technologies Pvt. Ltd., a high-technology software company headquartered in Bangalore, India. Soliton works with global companies, from start-ups to Fortune 500, across industries including Semiconductors, Medical Devices, Automotive, Industry 4.0, and Robotics to help them increase their competitiveness and release great products through Software Engineering Services. Since 1997, we have been growing over 25% annually because we especially focus on raising our standards constantly, to deliver an excellent experience to both our customers and our employees. Soliton Technologies is a certified Great Place to Work® in the Mid-Sized Organizations Category, recognized and issued by the Great Place to Work® Institute. This certification is a testament to our focus on our values of Respect, Integrity, Excellence and Innovation. With a team of over 400 employees across the world, we forge ahead as engineers working to our heart’s content, moving humanity forward. 
 Additional Details: Work Location (Coimbatore): This role will require working from the office (WFO). For more information, visit https://www.solitontech.com/ and do read the Impact Report to get a glimpse of the first 25 years of our truly meaningful journey.
